verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README says the open-source Python library lets you automate the web 'with any LLM', which is a direct claim of being model-agnostic. A community user independently reports it is compatible with more models and that they ran it with Gemini. The evidence is thin, though: one first-party line and one hands-on report. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring different LLM providers or keys, an enumerated list of supported providers, clarity on whether the Cloud agent also accepts bring-your-own models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own LLM provider — the framework is model-agnostic rather than locked to one vendor's models

citations.quote: Want to automate the web at scale, from your own code, and with any LLM? Use the Python library
browser-use is compatible with more models, and has (much) more github stars. Coincidentally I played with it over the last weekend using Gemini model.
